thread:
sara_pm: Quick heads-up — planning to deprecate client SDK v2 and cut SDK v3 next Tue 10:00 PDT. Need owners for deploy, smoke checklist, rollback steps, and a short client comms draft. Who can take the deploy owner?

kevin_eng: I can own the deploy window. Planning to do a staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) across regions, 15m between stages.

juno_devex: I will draft the client comms and update the migration guide. Can someone drop the breaking-change summary I can copy?

liam_sdk: Breaking changes: auth header now uses `x-rdwd-token` (was `authorization`), default timeout dropped from 30s->15s, and removed the legacy `predict()` method in favor of `generate()`. I'll paste a short diff in docs after the PR merges.

ana_support: (I'm actually ana_support) Support prepping a one-pager FAQ and will queue common error messages + suggested fixes. ETA EOD today.

kevin_eng: Deploy plan:
- preflight: run smoke suite against staging (jobs/stage-smoke).
- canary: 10% region=us-west1 (10m observation).
- ramp: 50% (15m), 100% (15m).
- postcheck: run sampling evals and latency dashboards.

mike_oncall: Oncall will be on standby for the window. I'll own immediate rollback if error rate > 2% or P95 latency spike > 2x baseline.

sara_pm: Rollback criteria noted. Kevin, what is the rollback procedure?

kevin_eng: Rollback steps (short):
1) Hit the rollout API to revert route to v2:
```bash
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/rollout/revert -d '{"service":"sdk-client","to":"v2"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```
2) Scale down v3 pools: `infractl scale sdk-client-v3 0`
3) Scale up v2 if needed: `infractl scale sdk-client-v2 3`
4) Ping #incidents and @mike_oncall

liam_sdk: I'll make sure v2 tags and docker images are immutable and we have a fresh tag to redeploy. Also I'll open a hotfix branch for the docs so we can push quick clarifications if users hit migr issues.

juno_devex: Client comms draft (short):
"Hello — on Tue 10:00 PDT we will release SDK v3. v2 will be deprecated and go into read-only mode on Tue+30 days. v3 includes auth header changes and API name updates; see migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/migrate. If you rely on `predict()`, please switch to `generate()` before the release. Reach out to support@redwood.ai for help"

ana_support: I'll prepare the support canned responses: 3 variants (failed auth, method not found, timeout). Also scheduling a CS micro-training for tomorrow 09:30 to review.

kevin_eng: Smoke checklist (short):
- run `stage-smoke` suite ✅
- check token expiry handling (auth header) ✅
- run e2e example apps in staging (python/js) ✅
- monitor sample traffic through V2 fallback (simulate mismatch)

deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: 1976616000 (2026-03-24T17:00:00Z). Canary config saved to infra:rollouts/clientsdk/v3/canary-config.

sara_pm: Nice. Juno, can you add the comms to the release notes and ping the customers who have high usage? We should include a link to the migration checklist and the rollback timeline.

juno_devex: Yep — I'll add to release notes and send targeted DM to top 20 customers tomorrow morning. Draft will be in #eng-platform for review by 12:00 PDT.

liam_sdk: One more item: compatibility shim in the npm package to log deprecated header usage for one release cycle. Will open PR today and tag for v3.1 if we need to revert.

mike_oncall: For monitoring — please ensure these dashboards are created: tokens/auth failure rate, client method errors, P95 latency per region. If dashboards not ready, I won't be able to evaluate rollback thresholds quickly.

kevin_eng: I'll create the dashboards and add to the runbook (link after).

sara_pm: Final asks:
- kevin: deploy owner + runbook + dashboards (today)
- juno: comms + release notes (tomorrow morning)
- liam: docs diff + shim PR (today)
- ana_support: canned responses + CS sync (tomorrow 09:30)
- mike: be oncall for window (ack)

ana_support: ack, will be there.

mike_oncall: ack.

kevin_eng: ack. I'll post the final runbook link here when done.

sara_pm: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, drop a short msg here. Otherwise I'll close this thread once comms are sent. :thumbsup:
